message: You know, I’ve always believed that it’s better to be over-prepared than caught off guard, especially when it comes to storms. I recently stumbled upon some helpful tips about floods that I think are worth a look. It’s all about knowing what to do before the skies open up—because nothing says "I’m ready" like a well-stocked emergency kit, right? Have you ever had to prepare for a storm? What’s your go-to strategy? 🌧️
